title: Land, Wealth, and Taxation
title_zh: 土地、财富与税收
authors: Brunetti, Roberto, Gaigné, Carl, Moizeau, Fabien
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the role of land in wealth dynamics and its consequences on efficiency and inequality. We focus on the interplay among agents’ bidding for location, mortgage market imperfections, and inheritance in a model in which agents leave to their heirs financial bequests and their housing wealth. The borrowing constraint generates a housing return premium and spatial wealth sorting, which translate into persistent wealth inequality. Since altruism and the borrowing constraint distort land price formation, we show that taxing land rent transmitted between generations is optimal. Land taxation cannot be disconnected from taxation on intergenerational wealth transfers.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨土地在财富动态中的作用及其对效率与不平等的影响。我们聚焦于一个模型中代理人区位竞标、抵押市场不完善与遗产继承之间的相互作用，其中代理人向继承人遗赠金融资产及住房财富。借贷约束导致住房回报溢价与空间财富分层，进而转化为持续的财富不平等。由于利他主义与借贷约束扭曲了土地价格形成机制，我们证明对代际传递的土地租金征税是最优选择。土地税制无法脱离代际财富转移税制而独立存在。

title: Connecting the dots: how bilateral investment treaty networks influence inward foreign direct investment
title_zh: 连接点：双边投资条约网络如何影响内向外国直接投资
authors: Rui Xue, RunHan Wang, TianChen Chang, FeiFei Wang, Claude Baron
abstract: Bilateral investment treaties (BITs) are widely acknowledged as instruments for attracting inward foreign direct investment (IFDI), yet their effectiveness remains contested. By using a sample of 64 countries along the Belt and Road Initiative, this study employs the Quadratic Assignment Procedure to analyse the impact of BITs on IFDI and further explores how these effects vary across IFDI subnetworks with distinct structural characteristics. Our analysis yields three key findings. First, the effect of BITs on IFDI declined over time – it was strong between 2012 and 2016 but weakened after 2017 due to the emergence of alternative institutions and evolving geopolitical factors. Second, the impact of formal BIT protections is prominent in low-cohesion networks. However, in high-cohesion systems, densely connected networks rely more on informal enforcement mechanisms. Third, strong expropriation clauses enhance investment, whereas investor-state dispute settlement provisions have a limited effect. These results indicate that policymakers should pursue targeted BIT strategies, prioritizing partners with central network positions or those embedded in highly active, low-cohesion communities; furthermore, a pronounced focus on strengthening substantive protections over indiscriminate treaty expansion is suggested. By linking clause-level treaty designs to network characteristics, this study contributes to a more nuanced understanding of heterogeneous IFDI outcomes.
abstract_zh: 双边投资条约（BITs）被广泛视为吸引外商直接投资（IFDI）的工具，但其有效性仍存争议。本研究以"一带一路"倡议沿线64个国家为样本，采用二次指派程序分析BITs对IFDI的影响，并进一步探讨这些效应如何随具有不同结构特征的IFDI子网络而变化。分析得出三项关键发现：第一，BITs对IFDI的影响随时间递减——2012年至2016年间效应显著，但2017年后因替代性制度兴起及地缘政治因素演变而减弱；第二，正式BIT保护机制在低凝聚力网络中作用突出，但在高凝聚力系统中，密集关联网络更依赖非正式执行机制；第三，强有力的征收条款能促进投资，而投资者-国家争端解决条款效果有限。这些结果表明，政策制定者应采取针对性BIT策略，优先选择处于网络中心位置或嵌入高活跃度、低凝聚力社群中的伙伴国；同时建议重点强化实质性保护条款而非盲目扩大条约范围。通过将条款级条约设计与网络特征相联系，本研究有助于更细致地理解IFDI的异质性结果。

title: Poisoned air, shortened lives: PM2.5 exposure and premature mortality in Southern European cities
title_zh: 毒化空气，缩短寿命：PM2.5暴露与南欧城市过早死亡
authors: Elena Cottini, Lorena Popescu, Luca Salmasi, Gilberto Turati
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: This study examines the causal effect of P M 2.5 air pollution exposure on premature mortality in Southern European cities from 2010 to 2018. We leverage local variations in precipitation and wind speed as a source of random variation in P M 2.5 exposure. Using the Two-Sample Two-Stage Least Squares (TS2SLS) estimator to reconcile monitoring station-level and city-level data, our findings reveal a statistically significant increase in premature mortality caused by P M 2.5 . According to our preferred specification, a 1% increase in P M 2.5 causes a 0.82% rise in the under-65 mortality rate and a 0.93% rise in the infant mortality rate. The results are robust to alternative specifications. The most affected populations are those residing in urban areas (relative to suburban areas) and those living in cities located in richer regions (as opposed to poorer ones). We also examine the role of additional pollutants, finding further evidence for the importance of particulate matter.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了2010年至2018年南欧城市PM2.5空气污染暴露对过早死亡率的因果效应。我们利用降水和风速的局部变化作为PM2.5暴露的随机变异来源。通过采用两样本两阶段最小二乘估计量（TS2SLS）协调监测站点级与城市级数据，研究结果表明PM2.5暴露显著增加了过早死亡率。根据我们的首选模型设定，PM2.5浓度每增加1%，会导致65岁以下死亡率上升0.82%，婴儿死亡率上升0.93%。该结果在替代模型设定下依然稳健。受影响最严重的人群包括城市地区（相对于郊区）居民，以及位于较富裕地区（相对于较贫困地区）城市的居民。我们还考察了其他污染物的作用，进一步证实了颗粒物的重要性。

title: Expectation Conformity in Strategic Cognition
title_zh: 战略认知中的预期一致性
authors: Alessandro Pavan, Jean Tirole
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study situations in which players shape their own understanding of the game, as well as others’, through information acquisition, communication, and other forms of strategic cognition. We introduce the concept of expectation conformity: incentives to change cognition are stronger when others expect such changes and/or make similar changes themselves. Expectation conformity provides a revealed-preference characterization of equilibrium determinacy in cognitive games. When it fails, equilibrium cognition is unique, independently of cognitive costs. When it holds, suitable costs generate multiple equilibria. We illustrate the implications in two-player constant-sum and linear-quadratic-Gaussian games. The online supplement considers other forms of cognition.
abstract_zh: 我们研究玩家通过信息获取、沟通及其他形式的策略认知来塑造自身及他人对博弈理解的情境。我们引入预期一致性概念：当他人预期此类认知变化或自身做出类似改变时，改变认知的激励会更强。预期一致性为认知博弈中的均衡确定性提供了显示偏好特征。当预期一致性不成立时，均衡认知具有唯一性，且独立于认知成本；当预期一致性成立时，适当的成本会产生多重均衡。我们通过两人常和博弈与线性二次高斯博弈阐释其含义。在线附录则探讨其他形式的认知。

title: The Effect of Reminders for Self-Set Goals on Productivity
title_zh: 自我设定目标的提醒对生产力的影响
authors: Martin Abel, Tomoko Harigaya, Michael Kremer, S. Jessica Zhu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine how reminders for self-set goals influence productivity by analyzing data from 10,187 volunteer agricultural extension workers in Rwanda. We elicited workers’ goals and experimentally varied their salience through text reminders. Due to unforeseen logistical delays, approximately half of the treatment group received reminders after completing their tasks. We find that goal reminders received during the regular working period increased a productivity index by 0.08 standard deviations, while reminders sent late had no effect. Further analysis of heterogeneity by goal ambition quartiles reveals an inverted U-shaped relationship: reminders are effective for goals in the second and third quartiles, but ineffective for low or excessively high goals. These results suggest that workers who set ambitious yet realistic goals are more likely to respond to reminders and increase productivity, consistent with prior evidence on externally set goals.
abstract_zh: 我们通过分析卢旺达10,187名农业推广志愿者的数据，考察了自我设定目标的提醒如何影响生产率。我们收集了志愿者的目标，并通过短信提醒实验性地改变其显著性。由于不可预见的物流延误，约一半的干预组在完成任务后才收到提醒。研究发现，在正常工作期间收到的目标提醒使生产率指数提高了0.08个标准差，而延迟发送的提醒则无效果。进一步按目标抱负四分位数进行的异质性分析揭示了倒U型关系：提醒对第二和第三四分位数的目标有效，但对低目标或过高目标无效。这些结果表明，设定既有抱负又现实的目标的工人更可能对提醒做出反应并提高生产率，这与先前关于外部设定目标的证据一致。

title: Hidden support: long-term care insurance and women’s entrepreneurship
title_zh: 隐性支持：长期护理保险与女性创业
authors: Yuqing Han, Siyuan Wang, Yongwei Ye, Yi Zhang
abstract: This study examines the impact of China’s Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) policy on women’s entrepreneurship. Using data from the China Family Panel Studies over 2012–2020, we implement a staggered difference-in-differences design to estimate the causal effect of LTCI pilot implementation on women’s entrepreneurship. We find that LTCI significantly increases women’s likelihood of becoming entrepreneurs, with larger effects among households with lower wealth and those in which older family members are in poorer health. lowering young women’s perceived exposure to future risks and easing the caregiving demands they face within the family, thereby strengthening both their willingness and ability to engage in entrepreneurial activity. We further explore spillover effects on intrahousehold allocation and intergenerational outcomes. LTCI not only promotes women’s entrepreneurship but also narrows gender income disparities and improves children’s cognitive and non-cognitive development. Overall, our findings provide policy-relevant evidence for strengthening long-term care institutions and for designing complementary policies that advance women’s economic participation and gender equality.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国长期护理保险政策对女性创业的影响。基于2012-2020年中国家庭追踪调查数据，我们采用交错双重差分法估计长期护理保险试点实施对女性创业的因果效应。研究发现，长期护理保险显著提升了女性成为创业者的概率，这一效应在低财富家庭及家中老年成员健康状况较差的群体中更为显著。该政策通过降低年轻女性对未来风险的感知暴露度、缓解其家庭照护负担，从而增强了她们参与创业活动的意愿与能力。我们进一步探讨了该政策对家庭内部资源配置及代际结果的溢出效应：长期护理保险不仅促进了女性创业，还缩小了性别收入差距，并改善了子女的认知与非认知能力发展。总体而言，本研究为完善长期照护制度、设计促进女性经济参与及性别平等的配套政策提供了具有政策参考价值的实证依据。

title: Nonlinear Pricing in Oligopoly: How Brand Preferences Shape Market Outcomes
title_zh: 寡头市场中的非线性定价：品牌偏好如何塑造市场结果
authors: Renato Gomes, Jean‐Marie Lozachmeur, Lucas Maestri
abstract: We study oligopolistic competition by firms practicing second‐degree price discrimination. In line with the literature on demand estimation, our theory allows consumers' propensity to switch brands to vary with tastes for product quality. If low‐type consumers are sufficiently more (respectively, less) prone to switch brands than are high types, (i) quality provision is inefficiently low at the bottom (respectively, high at the top) of the product line, and (ii) informational rents are positive (respectively, negative) for high types and negative (respectively, positive) for low types. Interestingly, we show that an increase in the number of competing firms may decrease welfare (by tightening incentive constraints), so much so that monopoly may be welfare superior to oligopoly. Pure‐strategy equilibria fail to exist, resulting in price‐quality dispersion across firms, whenever the propensity to switch brands is sufficiently different across consumers types.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了实施二级价格歧视的企业在寡头竞争中的行为。与需求估计文献一致，我们的理论允许消费者转换品牌的倾向随其对产品质量的偏好而变化。若低类型消费者比高类型消费者更易（或更不易）转换品牌，则：（i）产品线底端（或顶端）的质量供给将出现低效不足（或过高）；（ii）高类型消费者获得正（或负）信息租金，而低类型消费者获得负（或正）信息租金。有趣的是，我们发现竞争企业数量的增加可能降低社会福利（通过强化激励约束），以至于垄断可能比寡头更有利于社会福利。当不同消费者类型的品牌转换倾向差异足够大时，纯策略均衡将不存在，导致企业间出现价格-质量离散现象。

title: Rational Expectations Fools' Bubbles
title_zh: 理性预期愚人泡沫
authors: Luis Araujo, Antonio Doblas‐Madrid
abstract: We develop a rational, Walrasian model of speculative bubbles inspired by the Kindleberger–Minsky view, which describes bubbles as wave‐like market processes. Touched off by an initial shock, price booms are initially self‐reinforcing but become self‐destructive later when prices surpass fundamental value. Previous models in this vein have been criticized due to ad hoc features, such as prices driven by behavioral forces or particular trading protocols. Our model allays these concerns by relying only on multidimensional uncertainty to prevent unraveling via backward induction. Standard market clearing, moreover, makes the model more compatible with established macroeconomic and asset pricing frameworks.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个受金德尔伯格-明斯基观点启发的理性瓦尔拉斯投机泡沫模型，该模型将泡沫描述为波浪式的市场过程。在初始冲击触发下，价格繁荣初期呈现自我强化特征，但当价格超越基本面价值后则转向自我毁灭。此前同类模型因依赖行为因素驱动价格或特定交易规则等特设性设定而受到批评。我们的模型仅通过多维不确定性来防止逆向归纳导致的泡沫瓦解，从而缓解了这些担忧。此外，标准市场出清机制使该模型与既有的宏观经济和资产定价框架更具兼容性。

title: The Label Trap: Unintended Consequences of Pesticide Labeling and the Power of Nudges
title_zh: 标签陷阱：农药标签的意外后果与助推的力量
authors: Juhui Chen, Zhipeng He, Junfei Bai
abstract: Presenting pesticide dosages in range formats (e.g., 10–40 g) is presumed to offer farmers flexibility to adjust dosage application based on pest or disease pressure, and thereby facilitating precise use. However, this conventional practice may unintentionally encourage pesticide overuse. Based on a lab‐in‐the‐field experiment, this study finds that approximately 65% of farmers disregard the minimum dosage when exposed to range‐based labels, anchoring instead on the upper bound. A nudge‐based label design, featuring reference points and brief explanatory cues, can significantly reduce pesticide use without restricting farmers' autonomy. These findings reveal both the hidden risks and promising potential of label‐based interventions, suggesting that thoughtfully designed labels can serve as a low‐cost, scalable policy tool for mitigating excessive chemical use problem in agriculture.
abstract_zh: 以范围形式呈现农药剂量（如10–40克）被认为能为农户提供灵活性，使其根据病虫害压力调整施药量，从而促进精准用药。然而，这一常规做法可能无意中助长农药过度使用。基于一项田间实验室实验，本研究发现约65%的农户在面对范围标签时会忽略最低剂量，反而以上限为锚定标准。一种基于助推设计的标签方案，通过设置参考点并辅以简要解释性提示，能在不限制农户自主权的前提下显著减少农药使用量。这些发现揭示了标签干预措施既存在潜在风险，也蕴含巨大潜力，表明精心设计的标签可作为低成本、可推广的政策工具，用于缓解农业中化学品过度使用问题。

title: Joint Inference for the Regression Discontinuity Effect and Its External Validity
title_zh: 断点回归效应及其外部有效性的联合推断
authors: Yuta Okamoto
abstract: The external validity of regression discontinuity designs is crucial for informing policy but is rarely examined in applied work. To advance empirical practice, we propose a joint inference procedure for the treatment effect and its local external validity, captured by the treatment effect derivative (TED), within a robust bias correction framework. We further introduce a locally linear treatment effects assumption, which extends the scope of the TED and enables identification and the construction of a uniform confidence band for extrapolated effects. These methods apply to most empirical studies. Empirical illustrations demonstrate their practical usefulness.
abstract_zh: 断点回归设计的外部有效性对于政策制定至关重要，但在应用研究中却鲜少被检验。为推进实证实践，我们提出了一种在稳健偏差校正框架内，对处理效应及其局部外部有效性（由处理效应导数TED衡量）进行联合推断的方法。我们进一步引入局部线性处理效应假设，该假设扩展了TED的适用范围，并能够识别外推效应并构建其一致置信带。这些方法适用于大多数实证研究。实证案例展示了其实际应用价值。
